dialogues.speaker: Arakavi
dialogues.text: Festival Utsava is getting closer. I wonder what melodies will be sung at the festival.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Festival Utsava...

dialogues.speaker: Arakavi
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} and Aranara must sing together at Festival Utsava.

dialogues.speaker: Arakavi
dialogues.text: #No need to worry, Nara {NICKNAME}'s voice will surely be warm and golden.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Song Gatherers...

dialogues.speaker: Arakavi
dialogues.text: #Thanks to Nara {NICKNAME}'s help, the Song Gatherers have learned many songs that had been forgotten many sunrises ago,

dialogues.speaker: Arakavi
dialogues.text: These songs, to Aranara, are like Nara's "treasure."

dialogues.speaker: Arakavi
dialogues.text: #The song gatherers and Nara {NICKNAME} went to look for treasures together, and are good friends.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Arakavi
dialogues.text: Goodbye, good friend of Aranara.

dialogues.speaker: Arakavi
dialogues.text: Golden Nara and Arama defeated Marana, and brought new story and new song with the Ashvattha...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Ashvattha...

dialogues.speaker: Arakavi
dialogues.text: A long, long time later, there will definitely be new Nara friends coming to Vanarana.

dialogues.speaker: Arakavi
dialogues.text: But the future Nara will not have to go to the Ashvattha to look for the melodies of today.

dialogues.speaker: Arakavi
dialogues.text: Because all Aranara and the leaves and soil of Vana will remember this Festival Utsava, remember the golden song.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Arakavi
dialogues.text: Goodbye, Golden Nara. Aranara will not forget you.

dialogues.speaker: Arakavi
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME}, we will not forget you. Even if we are no longer here one day, the forest will not forget. Even if the forest disappears one day, the earth will remember.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The song from Festival Utsava...

dialogues.speaker: Arakavi
dialogues.text: It was a song as golden as the sun, and I was proud to be a part of it. As the Golden Nara, you will always stay in my memories and the memory of Vanarana.

dialogues.speaker: Arakavi
dialogues.text: I'll leave the little one to you. This is the Singing Majalis, and she loves being surrounded by warm sounds. In the past, she was the emblem of us Song Gatherers. Flowers like her have all perished during Vanarana's destruction, and now, only one seed remains.

dialogues.speaker: Arakavi
dialogues.text: We did not think that this seed would never grow or bloom again... But I think that the song from Festival Utsava gave her a new lease on life. Please, take her with you and give her lots of warmth and light.
